integrity: A self-contained symbolic proof and finite test script are included. The script checks finite instances only; the general theorem rests on the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The new theorem is the graph-to-logic inclusion equivalence, its order embedding and cyclic meet. The modal semantic machinery and conditional non-elementarity/coNP hardness are inherited from cited work; no unconditionally non-elementarity is asserted. An equivalent specialization in literature indexed under different terms remains possible.
title: The surjective-homomorphism order inside K4-stable graph logics
